model.name: merge.foldSyncAcrossPanes
model.description: Expand/collapse folding SYNCS across all THREE merge editors (Local/Center/Repository): a SHARED _collapsedGaps Set is projected to each editor via editor.setHiddenAreas() (one state -> 3 aligned projections, NOT a per-editor folding-model event mirror). toggleGap(idx) is the user affordance -> applyFold. Aligned by conflicts[] per-editor ranges (R30.16 via getTopForLineNumber); spline+gutters reflow after.
